'''2010 Worlds Day 2 Thomas Whitley DS Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Thomas Whitley]] at [[2010 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Deck name on sheet: Build A Bear. Transcription note: sheet name "Thomas Whitley"; objective written on line 2 (line 1 is Knowledge And Defense); only 11 shields listed

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe|Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe (V)]]
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 7.1]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
